name: Kyanite
description: GPU-driven object renderer for Geometry Dash: triggers, culling and batching on the GPU

enabled.name: Kyanite enabled
enabled.description: Use Kyanite's renderer. Turn this off to draw levels with Geometry Dash's own renderer.

frame_timing.name: Log frame timing
frame_timing.description: Log an average breakdown of the frame every 5 seconds: FPS, group state updates, culling, sorted batch regeneration and drawing.

gpu_core_count.name: GPU core count
gpu_core_count.description: How many compute work groups the culling pass uses. 0 detects it automatically; set it by hand if detection fails. Higher values can help on large GPUs, lower values on small ones.

debug_tools.name: Debug tools
debug_tools.description:
F8 toggles Kyanite while playing, F9 opens difference mode (very unstable), F7 selects every object right of the screen in the editor.

Turns off the optimizations.

use_mapped_buffers.name: Persistently mapped buffers
use_mapped_buffers.description:
Writes buffers through a persistent mapping instead of uploading them.

Buggy on many drivers. Sometimes helps on integrated GPUs, usually hurts on dedicated ones.

disable_object_pulse.name: Disable object pulse
disable_object_pulse.description: Objects no longer pulse to the song.
